work_item.title: Write project summary to artifacts/project-summary.md
work_item.intent: Create a concise but comprehensive summary document of the Engineering Loop project (v11.3.0) that captures its purpose, architecture, key features, stage catalog, version history, directory structure, and non-goals. The document should serve as a quick reference for new contributors and stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Include project purpose: AI-assisted SDLC orchestration via persistent while-loop with dynamic graph construction
Include architecture overview: multi-project git submodule + LangGraph orchestrator with GraphBuilder/NodeRegistry/EdgeRulesEngine

Include key features: dynamic graph, auto-sizing, TDD per task, evidence gates, Pydantic structured output, independent verification, surgical CLI, context optimization, lessons system, continuous decisions
Include stage catalog summary (26 stages across 7 phases: init, design, architecture, implementation, verify/QA, deploy, documentation, post-loop)
Include version history highlights (v9.0.0 through v11.3.0)
Include directory structure showing framework layout (eng_loop/, stages/, skills/, references/, artifacts/)
Include getting started with basic CLI commands (submodule add, install, eng-loop --dynamic-graph)
Document is concise (readable in ~5 minutes) but comprehensive
Version numbers and feature descriptions match current state (v11.3.0 with context optimization: ProjectMap + ToolResultCache)

includes: Reading existing docs: README.md, CORE.md, ORCHESTRATOR.md, START.md, AGENTS.md, skill-index.md
Summarizing framework architecture, features, stages, and structure

edge_cases: Ensure version numbers and feature descriptions match current state (v11.3.0)
Directory structure should reflect actual layout (eng_loop/src/eng_loop/ with cli.py, graph_builder.py, node_registry.py, edge_rules.py, schemas.py, state.py, config.py, nodes/, tools/)
Avoid duplicating README.md - summarize and distill, don't copy
Stage count is 26 stages across 7 phases (not 24 stage files - some stages share files)
non_goals: Not a replacement for README.md - it is a condensed summary
Does not need to cover every stage procedure in detail
Does not need configuration reference or troubleshooting
success_metrics: Document can be read and understood in ~5 minutes
New contributor can understand what the project does, how it's structured, and how to get started
No factual inaccuracies regarding v11.3.0 features
